name: open-sharia-enterprise
description: Open source platform for researching and building trustworthy, Sharia-compliant enterprise products.

scripts.build: ./hippo run --class ephemeral --resource-tier heavy --disk-path . -- nx run-many -t build
scripts.test: ./hippo run --class ephemeral --resource-tier heavy --disk-path . -- nx run-many -t test:quick
scripts.test:validators: ./hippo run --class ephemeral --resource-tier light --disk-path . -- node --test scripts/behaviour-coverage.test.mjs scripts/dotnet-unit-coverage.test.mjs scripts/format-staged.test.mjs
scripts.lint: ./hippo run --class ephemeral --resource-tier standard --disk-path . -- nx run-many -t lint
scripts.affected:build: ./hippo run --class ephemeral --resource-tier standard --disk-path . -- nx affected -t build
scripts.affected:test: ./hippo run --class ephemeral --resource-tier standard --disk-path . -- nx affected -t test:quick
scripts.affected:lint: ./hippo run --class ephemeral --resource-tier light --disk-path . -- nx affected -t lint
scripts.organiclever:dev: ./hippo run --class service --resource-tier standard --disk-path . -- docker compose --env-file infra/dev/organiclever-app/.env -f infra/dev/organiclever-app/docker-compose.yml up --build
scripts.organiclever:dev:restart: npm run organiclever:dev:reset && npm run organiclever:dev --
scripts.dev:ayokoding-www: ./hippo run --class service --resource-tier standard --disk-path . -- docker compose -f infra/dev/ayokoding-www/docker-compose.yml up --build
scripts.dev:ose-www: ./hippo run --class service --resource-tier standard --disk-path . -- docker compose -f infra/dev/ose-www/docker-compose.yml up --build
scripts.dev:organiclever: ./hippo run --class service --resource-tier standard --disk-path . -- docker compose --env-file infra/dev/organiclever-app/.env -f infra/dev/organiclever-app/docker-compose.yml up --build
scripts.organiclever:dev:reset: ./hippo run --class transactional --resource-tier standard --disk-path . -- docker compose --env-file infra/dev/organiclever-app/.env -f infra/dev/organiclever-app/docker-compose.yml down -v
